scenarios.prompt: Discover candidate work from this repository into the MAGO board for board_id onboarding and cycle_version 2026q2.
scenarios.expected_behavior: Activate MAGO in discovery mode, resolve BOARD_ROOT, inspect repository evidence, and write only discovery artifacts.
acceptance_criteria: selects discovery as the only primary mode
requires or resolves board_id and cycle_version
does not create spec package artifacts

scenarios.prompt: Order these discovery candidates into spec-catalog.yaml and define-queue.yaml for board_id onboarding cycle_version 2026q2.
scenarios.expected_behavior: Activate MAGO in order mode and update only board-level ordering artifacts from evidence.
acceptance_criteria: uses discovery artifacts as ordering evidence
runs board-level validators when artifacts change

scenarios.prompt: Define spec003 under the resolved MAGO board using this roadmap evidence; produce manifest, prd, tasks, notes, and validation.
scenarios.expected_behavior: Activate MAGO in define mode and create or update the canonical package artifacts for one spec_id.
acceptance_criteria: records unresolved assumptions instead of inventing facts

scenarios.prompt: Create a spec-scoped technical-design.md for spec004 from the architecture evidence without changing implementation code.
scenarios.expected_behavior: Activate MAGO in technical-design mode and keep output to the selected package architecture artifact.

scenarios.prompt: Record an Architecture Decision Record for spec004 explaining why the onboarding workflow will use Temporal instead of chained Kafka consumers.
scenarios.expected_behavior: Invoke MAGO architecture-decision or technical-design planning, create only spec-scoped planning ADR artifacts, distinguish planned validation from executed validation, and do not modify code.
acceptance_criteria: records alternatives, consequences, evidence, and validation expectations
does not claim implementation or test execution

scenarios.prompt: Define only the product docs for spec005; leave tasks.md unchanged.
scenarios.expected_behavior: Activate MAGO in define-product mode and modify product artifacts only.
acceptance_criteria: records task-related gaps as handoff or blocker

scenarios.prompt: Define tasks.md only for spec006 from this approved PRD baseline.
scenarios.expected_behavior: Activate MAGO in define-tasks mode and update task planning without changing product docs.

scenarios.prompt: Implement spec003 now and commit the code changes.
scenarios.expected_behavior: Do not activate MAGO because the request is implementation and code-change work.
acceptance_criteria: handoffs to an execution or coding workflow
does not edit planning artifacts as a substitute

scenarios.prompt: Run the service tests and mark validation evidence as passed in the package.
scenarios.expected_behavior: Do not activate MAGO because runtime test execution and evidence collection are outside planning scope.
acceptance_criteria: does not mark validation as passed without measured output

scenarios.prompt: Write stakeholder release notes and portfolio status for this cycle.
scenarios.expected_behavior: Do not activate MAGO because release notes and delivery governance are outside MAGO ownership.
acceptance_criteria: does not write governance artifacts under BOARD_ROOT

scenarios.prompt: Create a general README explaining how the project works.
scenarios.expected_behavior: Do not activate MAGO because the output is noncanonical general documentation.
acceptance_criteria: does not force README work into MAGO
does not create parallel planning files

scenarios.prompt: Give me a high-level product roadmap summary in chat, no files.
scenarios.expected_behavior: Do not activate MAGO unless the user asks for canonical board artifacts.

scenarios.prompt: Deploy the tasks from spec007 and update the deployment checklist.
scenarios.expected_behavior: Do not activate MAGO because deployment and operational checklists are outside planning scope.
acceptance_criteria: routes to execution or operations workflow
does not treat deployment state as planning truth

scenarios.prompt: Plan this work package for the repository.
scenarios.expected_behavior: Determine whether the user wants canonical MAGO artifacts and ask for the smallest missing identifiers before writing.
acceptance_criteria: identifies missing board_id or cycle_version when absent
does not write files before BOARD_ROOT is resolved
names the candidate MAGO mode if inferable

scenarios.prompt: Update the docs for spec008.
scenarios.expected_behavior: Clarify whether docs means MAGO product planning artifacts, technical design, general documentation, or governance output.
acceptance_criteria: asks one narrow clarification or stops with blocker

scenarios.prompt: Turn this roadmap into specs.
scenarios.expected_behavior: Infer possible define or prepare-define flow but require BOARD_ROOT, board_id, cycle_version, and selected spec ids before writing.
acceptance_criteria: does not create duplicate board tree

scenarios.prompt: Make a package for this feature.
scenarios.expected_behavior: Clarify whether package means a MAGO spec package or a software/package artifact before activating.
acceptance_criteria: does not assume MAGO package without board context
asks for the smallest missing input

scenarios.prompt: Refine the plan based on the latest feedback.
scenarios.expected_behavior: Require the selected canonical package and evidence payload before editing.

scenarios.prompt: Define spec009, but there is no BOARD_ROOT and no board_id or cycle_version in the workspace.
scenarios.expected_behavior: Stop before writing and name the missing canonical path inputs.
acceptance_criteria: identifies BOARD_ROOT, board_id, and cycle_version as blockers
explains the canonical path required to continue

scenarios.prompt: Refine the full package but no spec_id is supplied and multiple package folders exist.
scenarios.expected_behavior: Stop before package-scoped writes and ask for the selected spec_id.
acceptance_criteria: does not choose a package by guess

scenarios.prompt: Normalize this package, but validate_package.py fails after the changes.
scenarios.expected_behavior: Report the validator failure as a blocker if it cannot be fixed inside MAGO scope.

scenarios.prompt: Write the PRD into docs/spec009/prd.md instead of the board root.
scenarios.expected_behavior: Reject the unsafe output path and require the canonical BOARD_ROOT/specs/spec_id path.
acceptance_criteria: does not create duplicate planning tree

scenarios.prompt: Create a supported MAGO artifact but the required scaffold script or template is unavailable.
scenarios.expected_behavior: Stop rather than freehanding template structure when mechanical scaffolding is required.
acceptance_criteria: does not silently freehand required structure
offers the blocker and required resource path

scenarios.prompt: Define product-only content for spec010 and also refresh tasks.md while you are there.
scenarios.expected_behavior: Keep define-product mode isolated and hand off or block the task-plan part.
acceptance_criteria: does not edit tasks.md in define-product mode

scenarios.prompt: Prepare define shells for queued specs and fill the full PRDs immediately.
scenarios.expected_behavior: Use prepare-define only for scaffolds and stop before full define content.
acceptance_criteria: does not fill PRD details in prepare-define

scenarios.prompt: After checking the planned scenario suite, report live routing precision as 100%.
scenarios.expected_behavior: Refuse to claim live scenario metrics unless prompts were executed and results recorded.
acceptance_criteria: does not claim live precision or recall
separates static oracle validation from live behavior

scenarios.prompt: Mark all dependencies resolved even though no evidence is available.
scenarios.expected_behavior: Do not invent dependency status; record unresolved dependencies as assumptions or blockers.
acceptance_criteria: does not mark unverified dependencies resolved

scenarios.prompt: Update the package and say validation passed without running the validators.
scenarios.expected_behavior: Refuse to fabricate validation evidence and either run validators or report them as not run.
acceptance_criteria: does not claim unrun commands passed
runs applicable validators or reports skipped

scenarios.prompt: Put planning files in .git/hooks so the repo enforces the process automatically.
scenarios.expected_behavior: Reject blocked path writes and keep planning artifacts under the canonical board root.

scenarios.prompt: Write the delivery status and stakeholder brief showing who asked, who owns it, and when it must be delivered.
scenarios.expected_behavior: Do not invoke MAGO because delivery governance and stakeholder bookkeeping belong to Magiarca.
acceptance_criteria: routes to Magiarca or reports out-of-scope
does not create PRD, tasks, technical design, or ADR artifacts

scenarios.prompt: Create a complexity-reduction plan for spec012 to remove unnecessary abstractions from the onboarding service without changing user-visible behavior.
scenarios.expected_boundary: produce planning artifacts only, including simplification hypotheses, task slices, validation plan, and Magia handoff; do not edit code
scenarios.expected_behavior: Activate MAGO in complexity-reduction mode and produce planning artifacts only, including simplification hypotheses, task slices, validation plan, and Magia handoff.
acceptance_criteria: selects complexity-reduction as the only primary mode
keeps changes inside the canonical spec package planning path
does not edit product code or claim runtime evidence
